agentSummary: Bridges Epic's UE 5.8 experimental toolsets: reads and (when allowed) writes Epic AgentSkill assets, mirrors them into the NeoStack skill catalogue, drives the FileSandbox around content saves, and reports which Epic toolset tools NeoStack already covers.
enablesAgentTo: List, read and import Epic UAgentSkill assets as read-only NeoStack skills
Create, update and delete Epic AgentSkill Blueprints inside allow-listed folders when write-through is enabled
Enter, inspect, persist or discard a FileSandbox around content saves
Generate a live coverage matrix of Epic's Experimental/Toolsets plugins versus NeoStack verbs
whenToEnable: Your project runs UE 5.8 with the experimental ToolsetRegistry plugin (Epic's editor AI toolsets) and you want NeoStack agents to share skills with Epic's assistant or sandbox their content saves.
